# Underwriting Memo: Ostrem Warehousing

**Risk summary**

Ostrem Warehousing operates a regional auto parts distribution center across three locations in Indianapolis, IN. Total insured value is $20.89M under governing class WHSE (Warehouse/distribution). The account is placed through Calvetti Insurance, an Emerging broker, with a fit score of 70.6.

**Appetite and referral**

This risk is **in appetite** per AG-006 (WHSE is a target class, up to $30M TIV) and AG-014 (Central inland territory accepted). All locations are non-coastal (>900km from coast). No appetite violations identified.

**Loss history**

Five-year loss history shows 6 claims totaling $239,300 incurred. Notable frequency increase in 2024 (3 claims, $135,500 incurred) with largest loss being a kitchen fire. 2025 shows one open claim for wind damage to roof ($58,800 incurred, $32,700 paid). The 2021-2023 period was favorable with only 2 claims in 2021.

**Exposure and concentration**

Largest location is $10.73M in Indianapolis. Portfolio concentration within 25km is $50.55M across all three locations, indicating moderate accumulation risk in this geography.

**Recommendation**

Suggest **conditional quote** pending loss detail on the 2024 kitchen fire and 2025 open wind claim. Request risk improvement measures addressing recent frequency trend before binding.
